findings.decision: Retain as a concrete alternative/custom-preparation evidence source; do not call it an implementable generation profile or use it to raise p_create. A generic description/relocation/link workflow is the candidate reuse path, not a separate Mothership engine.
findings.why_no_proposal: No measured creation share, edition-matched denominator, unmet-need or switching-intent observation; 341 backers and 15 prepared sets do not estimate those quantities.
findings.market_implication: Existence of custom surface preparation is better supported; the finished paper example also weakens an assumption that no usable alternative exists. Neither direction supplies a numerical weight.
findings.method_experiment: Not a new metric: existing resource_catalog / gm_materials / crowdfunding / event evidence contracts applied qualitatively. No new weights or active method change.

findings.conclusion: 15 advertised map/scenario sets,341 historical backers,3 publisher-reported one-shots and1 attributed custom-map artifact are different units; none is measured current GM creation share.

Three preparation fixtures reuse content.relocate/place_description/static_hazard/site_links and map.routes_and_barriers semantically. No runtime support or missing function established; existing043/044 referenced only, no scope extension or new task.
